description: Philadelphia judge orders Musk to attend hearing in DA challenge to $1m voter lottery; Reuters.
pasted_text:
Reuters/CNBC-sourced legal report (2024-10-30):
A Philadelphia judge orders that the case brought by the Philadelphia District Attorney challenging a $1 million-per-day voter lottery linked to Musk (described in coverage as an 'illegal lottery' challenge) has its hearing schedule changed. The hearing is moved up by a day. Musk is ordered to appear in person. Court language includes an order that all parties must be present at the time of the hearing.
Reported context: civil litigation over a large-dollar prize for registered voters associated with political advocacy, opposed by the Philadelphia DA as an illegal lottery under state law.
Source: https://www.reuters.com/legal/elon-musk-ordered-attend-1-million-voter-lottery-suit-hearing-philadelphia-cnbc-2024-10-30/
facts: In late Oct 2024, a Philadelphia judge issues an order in the civil case brought by the Philadelphia District Attorney over a $1 million-per-day voter lottery associated with Musk.
The DA’s suit characterises the prize scheme as an illegal lottery under applicable law.
The court moves the hearing up by one day.
The order requires Musk to appear in person at the hearing.
The written order states that all parties must be present at the time of the hearing.
Reuters reports the order on 30 Oct 2024 (via CNBC legal coverage syndication).

subject_quotes.text: It is further ordered that all parties must be present at the time of the hearing
subject_quotes.speaker: Philadelphia court order

notes: Short names: Musk, Philadelphia DA. Do not invent hearing outcome (appearance/order only). Prefer court-filing or trial-related leaf; not files-suit unless Musk is plaintiff. Include $1m/day lottery context, DA plaintiff, move-up of hearing, in-person appearance requirement.
